quests.title: Taste of Happiness

dialogue.t: My brothers have all done some self-reflection. Festival Utsava is a happy occasion, so Arapacati shouldn't get mad.
That's right, Arapacati. Don't get mad. Happy occasions should be celebrated with the "taste of happiness"!
It's time to show off the results of our cooking training!
I have been ready for a long while.
Yay, it's the Festival Utsava Feast! Paimon's been waiting for this!

dialogue.sit: Best we not get our hopes too high...

dialogue.t: Water from Vanarana is the best water and makes the best soup. Nara will love it for sure.
I shall deliver the "taste of happiness" to Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon, and let them "teach" my brothers.
It's the only way to make food Nara will like. That's how guests should be treated.
Would you mind teaching them to cook, Nara {NICKNAME}?
Would you mind teaching them to cook, Nara {NICKNAME}?
They're all ready. We can start now.
You must come, Nara {NICKNAME}.
Don't you worry, Nara {NICKNAME}, Araphala has prepared the Unrivaled Fresh Fruit for the festival!
Araphala sure moves fast, huh? Let's go check elsewhere.
Needs more of that "taste of happiness"...
Whoa, that's enough!
Huh? Hmm, Arapacati mentioned that we must make Nara happy with food, so Paimon is right. I'll add less of it...
There you go. That should do.
The Head Mushroom has been ready for a while now! My super fragrant Head Mushroom...
But I'm not very good at gauging the heat, so please come take a look, Nara {NICKNAME}...
Fire is kinda dangerous to Aranara, so let's go help to control it.
Will this do?
Yes! We'll have a supreme delicacy, you can bet on that!
The Best Water... But there's nothing's left of it after my practice runs. Would Nara {NICKNAME} mind getting some water from the north of Vanarana for Arapas?
Well, guess we ought to help out, {NICKNAME}.
We're back, Arapas! This is the Best Water!
Terrific! I can make the Best Soup so long as I have the Best Water. Nara {NICKNAME} will love it for sure!
Y'know, since the Aranara are making food for us so eagerly during this happy occasion, we should return the favor. What do you say?
Hmm... Maybe they'll like some Radish Veggie Soup! Let's show them what Nara cooking's all about!
Woohoo! And that's our piping-hot Radish Veggie Soup all ready to go! The Aranara should be done with their dishes too.

dialogue.section: Paimon, Arapacati, Arachatora, Arasaka, Arapas, Araphala

dialogue.t: You still have to ask {NICKNAME} to help, or you will end up cooking the same dishes as before.

dialogue.sit:
According to the improvement method from Paimon, Aranara finishes the dish under your guidance.
After that, you enjoy the dish with Aranara...

dialogue.t: How's the taste of true-blue gourmet Nara food, eh?
Hmm... While it was Arapacati's suggestion for Nara {NICKNAME} to teach my brothers...
Nara dishes... Is this what Nara call "the taste of happiness"?
Happiness is fleeing from me...
Vanarana's water is obviously the Best Water, so how did something like this get made from it?
The Unrivaled Fresh Fruit is still delicious, though. Yum.
Eh? You Aranara think it's awful? Paimon thought it was pretty yummy, though...
I have no idea how "awful" is supposed to taste, but the flavor of this dish... has "impact." You know, like the kind you get from running full-speed into a tree...
Wow... This has gotta be a massive case of culture clash.
Still, it's rude to say that, my brothers. You should be thanking Nara {NICKNAME} instead!
*whimper* I'm sorry...
Don't say "sorry"! Say "Thank you!"
Thank you, Nara {NICKNAME}...
But it's okay as long as Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon enjoy the food! Don't mind them. If our Nara friends are happy, we're happy.
That said, Nara {NICKNAME} is totally different from Nara Varuna, who told us a lot of things about "brothers(sisters)."
But Nara {NICKNAME} is very quiet. Are you feeling unwell?
Uh, say something, {NICKNAME}.
Is that so? I'm glad. Once again, thank you. These petals are from Arapacati and her brothers. They're for you, Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon.
We hope the two of you will enjoy more of the "taste of happiness" here in Vanarana!

quests.description: Time to witness the results of the “cooking training” of Arapacati’s brothers.
